title: Slow Cooker Chicken Tikka Masala
description: A hands-off slow cooker curry built around whole chicken breasts, shredded after cooking, with a full cup of 0% Greek yogurt stirred in once the sauce has cooled slightly. Great over rice or as a quesadilla filling.
ingredients: 1.3 kg (2.9 lb) boneless, skinless chicken breast, left whole
1 tbsp fresh ginger, peeled and finely chopped (or grated)
instructions: Add 1.3 kg whole chicken breasts, 28 oz crushed tomatoes, 1 chopped small onion, 2 tbsp garam masala, 1 tbsp dark brown sugar, 1 tbsp minced garlic, 1 tbsp kosher salt, 1 tbsp fresh ginger, 1/2 tsp ground coriander, and 1/2 tsp ground cumin to a 6-quart or larger slow cooker.
Stir everything together well so the spices and brown sugar are evenly distributed before cooking.
Cover and cook on High for 2 hours 30 minutes, until the chicken is fully cooked and shreds easily.
Remove the chicken breasts and shred with two forks, then return the shredded chicken to the pot.
Let the mixture cool slightly, then stir in 1 cup of 0% Greek yogurt. Adding it after cooling keeps the sauce from splitting.
Serve over rice, or use as a filling for quesadillas.
notes: Makes 8 portions. Protein density lands right around 16g protein per 100 calories — a strong number for a curry. Shredding after cooking gives a better texture for quesadilla filling than chunks.
